review: read-only followup on ResearchIntake and source_rechecks boundaries

findings.priority: P1/P2 correctness and unintended paid execution
findings.original_trigger: Preflight reuses an intake id based on client_request_id, but previously displayed the new request topic while confirmation consumed the old stored request.
findings.current_source_status: Coordinator added sameRequest validation for stored preflight requests, uses the stored displayed topic and binds mode/thread/data-policy/attachments/client id in requireConfirmed.
findings.verification_boundary: Four actual PostgreSQL ResearchIntakeIntegrationTest cases passed including conflicting id and confirmed mode rejection; see scope-intake.json.

findings.trigger: Confirmation acquires the intake row lock before commands.create, while a direct create request can acquire global queue/workspace locks before requireConfirmed acquires the intake row. Concurrent requests can form a lock cycle.
findings.current_source_status: Confirm now obtains commands.lockIntakeAdmission before owned() takes the intake row; same global queue then workspace advisory locks as direct create. Nested create reacquires same transaction locks.
findings.verification_boundary: Original issue was source-derived without concurrent reproduction. Fixed order confirmed in current source; four real PostgreSQL integration cases plus isolated scope browser acceptance pass; no production deadlock or stress claim.

confirmed_controls: current report visibility and local-document ACL before access
body-change status explicitly separated from factual truth
source_rechecks.limitation: This is source review plus existing named component receipts, not a penetration test or a new live-web test. Extraction changes, page nondeterminism and inaccessible pages still require cautious interpretation.

mutations_by_this_review: none to the reviewed intake/recheck implementations; findings were handed to the coordinator
